entries.why: APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #556 review: B1/B2 replace reviewed controls with shadcn primitives, lock registered series date/frequency/zone, show check failures, and route edits through a server transaction. Existing creation, payment and navigation behavior retained.
APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #556 review: B1 replaces calendar, run selection, question stepper and submit controls with shared primitives, preserving existing handlers and payment copy.
APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #556 review: B1 changes only the reviewed Add to calendar control to the shared Button with existing handler and density.

APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #556 review: F1/F3 require current users/{uid} tenant membership for restricted events and include the selected civil run date in confirmation emails. Payment and CRM writes retained.

APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #556 review: B1/B2 append real-DOM primitive assertions, disabled schedule fields, editable start time and failed-read coverage. Existing save assertions use the new server-save client boundary; all original tests retained.

APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #556 review: B1 appends a rendered question-stepper regression covering Input, Textarea, RadioGroup, exclusive selection and Button through submission. Prior assertions retained.

APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #556 review: F1/F3 append stale-token, removed membership, read-failure and selected-run email regressions. Existing signed-in tests now supply the authoritative user document; prior assertions retained.
APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #556 review: Append only the reviewed event-save and submit-route digest pins; prior pins and all assertions retained.

APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #556 review: Append reviewed event-save and submit-route digest pins, and assert the exact shadcn primitive imports required by B1. No raw-control exemptions; prior pins and all other assertions retained.
APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #556 review: Append only the reviewed submit-route digest for F1/F3; preserve previous pin and every money-path, height and date guard.
APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #556 review: Append only the reviewed AdminEvents digest for B1/B2; previous pins and all navigation, permission and sidebar assertions retained.

APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #556 review: B2 adds a manageEvents-protected server edit endpoint with a current registration check inside the save transaction, refusing series identity changes with a visible conflict. Lock-state reads fail visibly.

APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #556 review: B2 covers day, frequency, zone and recurrence removal conflicts, registrations arriving after the editor opens, allowed details/time changes, failed reads and tenant permission checks. Removing the lock fails five cases.
APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #556 review: B2 compares recurrence identity using the event-zone civil start day, frequency and time zone while permitting time-of-day changes.
APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #556 review: B2 composes shared Inputs into a disabled start date and editable start time for locked series, retaining the normal datetime field for unlocked edits.

APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #556 review: B2 sends authenticated edit/lock requests, serializes event dates for the server and throws server/read failures instead of silently unlocking or reporting success.

APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #556 review: B1 checks parser-stripped JSX controls, raw-control count ceilings and the question editor/stepper primitive-only subtrees. Replacing the Add button with a raw control fails this guard and the UI regression.

APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #556 review: B1 final shared input density and left-aligned filter treatment, with B2 lock and transactional server save retained. No primitive edits or raw-control allowlist additions.
APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #556 review: B1 final public input uses shared control density; question and calendar behavior, payment copy and guards retained.
APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #556 review: B2 final split field keeps the mobile touch floor and existing desktop density for the disabled day and editable time.
APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #556 review: Append final AdminEvents digest only, keeping every previous digest and navigation assertion.

APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #556 review: B1 reuses unchanged digest-pinned Input classes and the existing Button outline variant instead of adding per-class allowlist entries; all ministry measurements and baseline fixtures remain. B2 pins the exact smaller client path set and explicitly requires server-save delegation with no direct edit updateDoc. Append the correlated source digest/line count; retain prior pins. A custom palette/height mutation is rejected.
APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #556 review: B2 append untouched Timestamp precision and affirmative editor-lock tests; retain all schedule-conflict, permission, failure and stale-editor regressions.

APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #556 review: B2 verifies authenticated date serialization, explicit lock booleans and rejected server/malformed responses so the client cannot report false success or silently unlock.
APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #556 final: Keep omitted date fields absent on partial updates, while explicit nulls clear them and actual timestamps serialize. Existing failure propagation retained.
APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #556 final: Append regression proving partial updates cannot silently clear omitted event dates; all prior serialization and failure assertions retained.

APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #556 final: Expand primitive assertions to the reviewed search, sharing, answer expansion, cancellation, calendar and date/ticket selection controls. No raw-control allowance changes.
